subject: GEN3 ALPHA1 INTEGRATED PACKAGE READY FOR CI VALIDATION
body: Primary has assembled the first integrated Gen3 Alpha1 package against production baseline 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. No production GitHub runtime write has occurred yet. Package applies Phase1 V4 exact-CAS cover authority first, then integrates service-stable close-cycle prime admission, newest-STARTED frame fencing, one exact cover visual attempt owner, one dedicated privileged shader host, frozen canonical right-pane closing content, live-blur opening backend, Shizuku privilege-loss recovery fencing, exact visual correlation events, and full removal of the experimental WindowArea dual-screen path. Existing 3/8/174/135/140/172/166 thresholds, right-pane geometry, early inner wake, no-raw-OFF and no-task-migration invariants are preserved. Local primary validation: pure ownership model PASS; focused integration invariants 5/5 PASS; new Android Gen3 host/coordinator type-check against stubs PASS; both Python patchers compile; workflow YAML parses; all live-main Alpha1 patch anchors audited exactly once; ZIP integrity PASS. The package is intentionally fail-closed: GitHub workflow verifies exact source blobs, applies Phase1 then Alpha1, runs focused tests plus testFullDebugUnitTest/assembleFullDebug, and commits app/** only after all gates pass. This is a FUTURE-STATE candidate until CI succeeds and primary revalidates the resulting main commit.
